document_data.title: Referral Letter to Dr. Kim
document_data.content:
Dear Dr. Kim,

I am writing to refer Brian Turner for further evaluation based on his recent workplace fitness evaluation. The findings indicate that he has chronic knee pain, and prior preferences documented suggest he does not wish for external referrals but has consented to insurer sharing, hence I’m forwarding this matter for your review.

Please let me know your thoughts on his management plan and if any additional information is required.

Best regards,
Dr. Ana Rivera
